headline: TT&A, Watson Farley & Williams advise Asian Development Bank on sanctioning $100 million to Kisetsu Saison Finance
sum: Asian Development Bank has sanctioned an ECB facility amounting to $100 million availed by Kisetsu Saison Finance (India) Private Limited. TT&A advised Asian Development Bank on this financing transaction.
detail: Asian Development Bank has sanctioned an ECB facility amounting to $100 million availed by Kisetsu Saison Finance (India) Private Limited. TT&A advised Asian Development Bank on this financing transaction. The transaction team consisted of Ambarish Mohanty (Partner), Ankita Mandal (Managing Associate) and Sajjan Singh (Senior Associate). Ambarish Mohanty Watson Farley & Williams acted as the International Legal Counsel to Asian Development Bank.
